name: edge2-replay-scan-harness
description: Not the app itself (edge2 has no build step — index.html loads app.js/core/*.js/engines/*.js directly). This package.json exists solely to run the Playwright replay-scan harness in scripts/replay-scan.mjs. Deliberately NOT "type": "module" — every tests/*.test.js is a plain CommonJS script (require('assert')), and that field is repo-wide, not scoped to scripts/. replay-scan.mjs already gets ESM treatment from its own .mjs extension, independent of this field, so leaving it unset is what keeps the existing test suite running at all.
